info.title: Naija Tickets API — Phase 3
info.description: Server-to-server integration identity, assigned event/ticket/availability reads and opt-in hosted checkout with minimal attributed session status. Requires matching deployment/database environment and separate signing configuration. Test business operations require a separate sandbox project/deployment and Paystack test key. No widget, partner ticket/attendee API or outgoing webhooks.

servers.description: Deploy Phase 3 source and apply migrations before use; hosted checkout remains disabled until explicitly configured.

get.summary: List assigned, published events that have not ended
get.description: Requires events:read. Event grants, ownership, active credential, issuer management permission and live mode are rechecked in the database. No CORS/browser secret-key use. Unknown/repeated query parameters are rejected.

parameters.description: Inclusive event start lower bound. ISO timezone required; at most three fractional second digits.

parameters.description: Exclusive event start upper bound. ISO timezone required; at most three fractional second digits.

post.summary: Create or replay a hosted checkout intent
post.description: Requires checkout:write and Idempotency-Key. No stock is held and no order/ticket/payment is created until the customer submits the hosted form. Inputs cannot include price, customer identity or attendee details. Max 400 admissions and per-tier sale/order restrictions apply. Session lifetime up to 30 minutes, bounded by issuing credential expiry.

200.description: Private, no-store response with request ID. Replays return the original session.

400.description: Invalid body, query, selection, Idempotency-Key or registered return URL.

401.description: Invalid, expired, revoked or disabled credential.

403.description: Required scope missing or browser Origin denied. Server requests only.

404.description: Session/event not found within the authenticated application and current event grant.

405.description: Wrong method; Allow header names the supported method.

409.description: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT for changed payload; CHECKOUT_CONFLICT for unavailable selection or other booking conflicts.

503.description: CHECKOUT_NOT_CONFIGURED, SANDBOX_NOT_CONFIGURED or dependency outage; never falls back to live resources.

IntegrationSecret.description: Requires integration:read. Credentials are secret server keys, not widget identifiers.

CheckoutSession.description: Minimal status of this integration-attributed session. Monetary fields are null before reservation. Admissions include unclaimed group slots; tickets_issued counts usable claimed/checked-in tickets, not unclaimed group slots. Paid/refund status requires stored verified payment. No private receipt, purchaser, attendee or QR data.

checkout_url.description: Short-lived private buyer capability. Return to the buyer only; redact from logs and analytics. It is not a server API credential.

popup_url.description: Optional private, short-lived checkout modal URL when the server enables popup checkout. Use the official checkout-v1.js SDK. Frame access lives in the URL fragment. Do not log or persist this URL.

promo_code.description: Optional code; normalized to uppercase and validated during authoritative reservation.

return_url.description: Exact registered origin plus simple path. No credentials, query, fragment, percent escapes or backslashes. HTTPS; test localhost HTTP allowed.

cancel_url.description: Same restrictions as return_url; defaults to return_url.
